correctness.rationale: In the incidence orientation of the finding, the positive feasible point c=1/d makes the affine tangent space T=ker B; connectivity gives rank 2n-1 and D=m-2n+1>0. Bipartite matching integrality supplies the full inequality description. The projector P=I-B^T(BB^T)^+B has P_ee=1-R_eff(e). Constancy forces P_ee=s^2=D/m. The intrinsic distances from c to every coordinate hyperplane are (ds)^(-1), and the nearest points c-r P e_e/s lie in the contained ball, hence in the polytope; they really are supporting contacts. The normalized outward unit normals u_e=-P e_e/s have zero weighted first moment because P1=0 and identity weighted second moment on T because sum_e (P e_e)(P e_e)^T=P^2=P. Both John conditions hold with weights D/m, with repeated contacts combined if needed. Any ball of radius rho implies a_e>=rho s for each center coordinate, and summing gives n>=m rho s; at equality every a_e=1/d. This also proves incenter uniqueness independently. Substitution verifies the crown and cube examples, including a cycle where D=1. The frozen exact rational checker was inspected but not executed; the general proof supplies the result directly.
residual_risks: The proof requires constant leverage/edge resistance, not regularity alone. It neither promises distinct contact points nor requires every distinct hyperplane to define a distinct facet.
